reuse.why: Changes only the existing shared getRangedScheduleAmount/getExpectedScheduleAmount helpers and keeps using getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance; every consumer already goes through them.

duplication.why: No logic is added outside the shared helpers; the approx branch even gets simpler.

placement.why: The rule change lands in shared/schedules.ts where the tree defines the expected schedule amount.

scope.why: Helper body, its tests, the call-site comments describing the rule, and a release note; nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: Clean single-definition change; the rule is still restated in comments at three call sites (forecast, two in schedules/app), which have to be edited along with every rule change.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All planning paths (preview, posting, updateActions, forecast, budget template, API via getScheduledAmount) use getExpectedScheduleAmount.

one_place.where: shared/schedules.ts getRangedScheduleAmount and getExpectedScheduleAmount, which every code path that applies the rule calls (directly or through getScheduledAmount).
